title: BLACKLIST/WHITELIST BY MEY
features:
When you blacklist someone everytime they join your server when you are admin it silenty glitches and mutes the person you blacklisted automatically everytime they rejoin When you whitelist someone it silenty gives enlighten to them When they rejoin or are in the server 
Recommend for admin only.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local blacklisted = {}
local whitelisted = {}

local function sendChatMessage(message)
    pcall(function()
        local channels = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels")
        local general = channels:WaitForChild("RBXGeneral")
        general:SendAsync(message)
    end)
end

local function findPlayer(partialName)
    local search = partialName:lower()

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Name:lower():sub(1, #search) == search
            or player.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #search) == search then
            return player
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function blacklistPlayer(searchName)
    local player = findPlayer(searchName)
    local key = searchName:lower()

    blacklisted[key] = true
    whitelisted[key] = nil

    if player then
        blacklisted[player.Name:lower()] = true
        blacklisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = true

        sendChatMessage(player.Name .. " has been blacklisted.")

        sendChatMessage(";mute " .. player.Name)

        task.wait(0.5)

        sendChatMessage(";glitch " .. player.Name)
    else
        sendChatMessage(searchName .. " has been blacklisted.")
    end
end

local function whitelistPlayer(searchName)
    local player = findPlayer(searchName)
    local key = searchName:lower()

    whitelisted[key] = true
    blacklisted[key] = nil

    if player then
        whitelisted[player.Name:lower()] = true
        whitelisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = true

        blacklisted[player.Name:lower()] = nil
        blacklisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = nil

        sendChatMessage(player.Name .. " has been whitelisted.")
        sendChatMessage(";Enlighten " .. player.Name)
    else
        sendChatMessage(searchName .. " has been whitelisted.")
    end
end

sendChatMessage("Blacklist whitelist script loaded credits to me_meymeyme Use !whitelist username Or !blacklist username")

TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
    local text = message.Text

    if text:sub(1, 11):lower() == "!blacklist " then
        local username = text:sub(12):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        if username ~= "" then
            blacklistPlayer(username)
        end

    elseif text:sub(1, 11):lower() == "!whitelist " then
        local username = text:sub(12):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        if username ~= "" then
            whitelistPlayer(username)
        end
    end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    task.wait(0.2)

    local username = player.Name:lower()
    local displayName = player.DisplayName:lower()

    if blacklisted[username] or blacklisted[displayName] then
        blacklisted[username] = true
        blacklisted[displayName] = true

        sendChatMessage(";mute " .. player.Name)

        task.wait(0.5)

        sendChatMessage(";glitch " .. player.Name)

    elseif whitelisted[username] or whitelisted[displayName] then
        whitelisted[username] = true
        whitelisted[displayName] = true

        sendChatMessage(";Enlighten " .. player.Name)
    end
end)
